findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.
One hue for the series that matters, a neutral for the rest, and at most four series colours in total; status colours only for status.

findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.
An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).
